title: Use Canva's video timeline to arrange layers
note: In Canva's video editor, timeline tracks show how clips, graphics and audio are arranged over time. Move an element left or right to shift when it appears and between tracks to change layer ordering. Timeline mode differs from Page Mode, where some timing controls are unavailable.

title: Split a clip or element in Canva Video Timeline
note: In Canva Video Timeline mode, select the element, position the playhead and choose Split in its More menu, or press S. You can edit the resulting segments separately. If a split option is missing, check whether the design is currently in Page Mode.

title: Add video transitions between Canva clips
note: In Canva's Video Timeline, hover between two adjacent clips on the main track and select Add transition. Pick a style and adjust available duration or direction settings. Video transition controls are unavailable in Page Mode.

title: Arrange music and sound effects on Canva video tracks
note: Use Add Audio in Canva's video timeline to add library music, sound effects, uploaded audio or eligible generated voice. The audio appears in its own track, and multiple audio tracks can be arranged and timed against footage.

title: Change when a Canva video element appears
note: In Canva Video Timeline mode, select an element and drag the left or right edge to adjust its start or end time. Move the entire element to shift its timing without changing duration. Animated element speed is a separate control under Animate.
